org_sub: JavaScript and TypeScript toolkit · pure Common Lisp · https://clun.sh
subject: Clun operator standard operating procedure (clone, build, gates, install, release)
opening: Bottom line: Clun is a Bun-shaped JavaScript and TypeScript toolkit implemented only in pure Common Lisp. Operators clone, build with SBCL, run purity and test gates, ship through Issue to PR to master, and publish installable tags only after assets and the release ledger agree. Published install boundary remains v0.2.2 until candidate 0.3.0 ships.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: This memorandum is the living operator handbook for Clun. It states how to clone the repository, build the runtime image, run quality gates, install for end users, and ship a versioned release without publication gaps.

sections.heading: 2. Scope
sections.body: This SOP covers full project operations. It does not replace the man page, README narrative, capability matrix, or https://clun.sh. Those remain the public ship surfaces.

clone, build, and local binary checks
quality gates (build, test, purity, claims, man)
release ship flow and Pages deploy

sections.heading: 4. Product laws (non-negotiable)
sections.body: Permanent product law (Epic #177 FULL PORT): every matrix row is a full-port target until Yes. Qualified Yes is a No. Soft ledger detail is forbidden while status is Yes.

steps.text: Prime directive: exceed Bun, npm, and matrix peers for every shipped surface. Implementation language is pure Common Lisp.
Purity: no CFFI, native libraries, implementation JS/TS, or shell-outs as product implementation shortcuts. Enforce with make purity.
No hollow exports: every exported API must perform real work or must not be exported. Zero product hollows (Issue #339 closed inventory).
Man page hard rule: man clun content must always match actual current CLI functionality. Source of truth is src/cli/catalog.lisp. Regenerate with make man. make man-check fails on drift.
Ship path: Issue then branch feat/issue-N-... then PR then squash-merge into master. Do not use direct push to master as the ship path.
Publication order after merge when release-bearing: tag merge SHA, release assets and checksums, ledger/README/site, Pages, install smoke, Issue evidence. Never move or reuse tags.

sections.heading: 7. Prerequisites
sections.body: Host toolchain for operators and CI: SBCL 2.6.4 on PATH with thread support, and GNU Make. No Quicklisp. All CL dependencies are vendored under vendor/ and located via scripts/registry.lisp. Supported release platforms for end-user binaries are Linux and macOS on x64 and arm64.

sections.heading: 8. Procedure — clone and build
sections.body: A fresh clone builds with make build alone. ASDF compiles the vendored closure and src/ into the per-user fasl cache. Nothing else is fetched.

steps.text: Clone the repository and enter the tree.
Confirm SBCL version on PATH.
Build the runtime image.
Confirm the binary version string.

sections.heading: 9. Procedure — quality gates
sections.body: Run the unit gates before merge. Release-bearing units add version-transition and publication checks per docs/versioning.md and the Issue SemVer disposition.

steps.text: Build.
Run the full test harness.
Fail closed on foreign-code tokens.
When CLI surface changes, regenerate and check man.
When public docs or roadmap change, run claims and roadmap checks.
For release-bearing units, bound the version transition.

rows: CLI surface or man generation changes
README, site, ledger, or public claims change
Exact-master and tag gates per CI

sections.heading: 10. Procedure — end-user install and update
sections.body: The curl installer is the primary install path. It verifies SHA-256 and installs to ~/.local/bin/clun. The man page installs with the package. The built-in updater uses pure Common Lisp HTTPS against the same release assets.

steps.text: Install the verified published boundary (currently v0.2.2 until 0.3.0 publishes).
Optional: pin a version.
Check for updates without mutating.
Activate the complete release bundle when behind.
Confirm man page matches the installed CLI.

sections.heading: 11. Procedure — release and ship
sections.body: Classify SemVer impact on the canonical Issue before merge. Source version, ASDF core, installer default, README, and site must agree for the unit. Candidate work may advance src/version.lisp while verified_installer_tag stays on the last published tag.

steps.text: Record SemVer impact, version, and tag on the Issue (and release ledger).
Land the unit on master via squash-merge when gates are green.
Update NASA SOP source and PDF. Write the NASA release memo for this version. Update CHANGELOG.md, README Documents links, and site Documents links.
Tag the merge SHA as vX.Y.Z. Do not move or reuse tags.
Publish GitHub Release assets: four native archives, checksums.txt, install script, man page bundle, SOP PDF, release memo PDF.
Advance the release ledger and verified installer boundary only after assets exist.
Confirm Pages deploy and smoke https://clun.sh/install.
Post publication evidence on the Issue.

sections.heading: 12. Procedure — documentation and NASA cadence
sections.body: House prime directive: every release or deploy updates README, NASA SOP, website (site/), and NASA changelog memo. Any ops or docs commit mid-cycle updates the NASA SOP source and PDF in the same change set. Man, README, and Pages facts stay in sync.
items: README Documents section links SOP and memo directly
site/ Documents section carries the same links
Graphical flowcharts required in the SOP for real processes; no ASCII diagrams in PDFs

sections.heading: 13. Zero-stubs and hollow export rule
sections.body: Issue #339 closed the residual zero-stubs inventory. Mechanical scan plus review reports ZERO_PRODUCT_HOLLOWS. Only documented intentional design no-ops remain (for example MessagePort auto-start recording, honest non-FIPS). Depth quality such as full HPACK peer interop remains progressive, but exported APIs must not ignore arguments and return undefined as a hollow shell.

sections.heading: 14. Daily operator checklist
items: Work from a canonical Issue with clear SemVer disposition
Run make build, make test, make purity before PR
Regenerate man when CLI changes; never hand-edit docs/man/clun.1
Sync README, site, STATE, and Issue when public claims move
Update SOP PDF when operator process changes
Never soft-Yes an incomplete matrix row

rows: Remove CFFI/foreign or shell-out shortcut; restore pure CL path
Run make man from catalog; do not hand-patch man source
Reconcile README, site, compat ledger, and Issue facts
Installer still on old tag after ship

Resolve candidate vs published state in release.tsv; fix installer boundary
Destub or un-export; update inventory; never leave soft Yes

sections.heading: 17. Approval and control
sections.body: Document control: SOP-CLUN-OPS-001. Version string tracks the operator surface for the current candidate train. Update this SOP on every ops or docs process change and on every release. Render with the house memo-pdf nasa-sop template. Maintainers approve content by merging the documenting commit to master.
